correctness.rationale: Exactly specified internal zero gaps have binomial-ratio probability, so joint factorial moments of counts of gaps 0,...,k-2 converge to independent Poisson(c²) moments. The endpoint and triple-window failure estimates are O_k(r/n+r³/n²)=o(1) at r~c√n. On their complement, each histogram coordinate is reconstructed by disjoint window counts, and the pair-mer coordinates recover every gap count; total-variation convergence then gives the Bessel collision product. Direct stars-and-bars counts the all-separated reference event and its sharp threshold. The standalone code independently exhausts 12,365 good words and 379 separated-event cases; simulation is illustrative only.

value.rationale: The exact read multiplicity observation is a natural reconstruction statistic. At r~c√n the profile abruptly changes from a deterministic separated signature to a genuinely random k-1-dimensional independent-Poisson family; the explicit Bessel collision probability gives a nontrivial quantitative ambiguity law. The result also supplies an exact finite-n separated-signature probability and a sharp threshold. These motivated statements do not follow merely by renaming one known Poisson count.
